panel.permission.title: Coding permissions
panel.permission.hint: Choose how N.E.K.O. confirms edits and terminal commands.
panel.permission.askDesc: Always ask before edits; confirm every terminal command.
panel.permission.auto_editDesc: Apply edits automatically; safe tests/builds run, risky commands ask.
panel.permission.full_accessDesc: Edit and run commands without asking; catastrophic commands are still blocked.
panel.permission.terminalHint: When off, no permission mode can run terminal commands.
panel.task.emptyHint: Tasks appear here after N.E.K.O. reads or edits code.
panel.live.title: Runtime status
panel.direct.title: Run a coding task directly
panel.direct.hint: Use this when N.E.K.O. does not call the plugin. It runs through the bound Coding model and actually changes workspace files.
panel.direct.placeholder: Example: change the title in src/App.tsx to “Hello” and run the tests
panel.takeover.title: Coding takeover
panel.takeover.hint: Auto takes over explicit coding requests from chat so real file edits do not depend on the main model calling a tool.
panel.budget.title: Runtime budget
panel.budget.hint: Defaults favor long tasks. 0 means no limit (or client default for the model request timeout).
panel.budget.maxStepsHint: 0 = no step limit. Positive values only cap model turns.
panel.budget.taskTimeoutHint: 0 = no overall timeout. Cancel from the runtime card at any time.
panel.budget.modelTimeout: Model request timeout, seconds (0 = client default)
panel.budget.modelTimeoutHint: Per model request. Increase it for very long thinking; 0 uses the client default.
